band.basis: Lump sum for the fixed scope, GST-exclusive, Auckland, 2025/26. Sum of the components above: low $78,511, high $148,973, midpoint ~$113,700. Implied rate over the 250m nominal route: low $314/m, high $596/m, midpoint ~$455/m. Built from QV CostBuilder rows (unreviewed, caveated) plus two fetched NZ supplier prices and stated allowances. Confidence is LOW: the QV buried-conduit subsection is internally inconsistent (50mm $77/m vs 100mm $45.80/m) and the conduit line alone is ~37-46% of the band; the pits and the 4-core 25mm2 sub-main are priced from proxies with stated adjustments because QV publishes no matching rows. Component subtotals (low-high): trenching and reinstatement ~$10,900-$27,700; conduit and cable ~$49,300-$89,000; pits ~$13,100-$19,700; board and spurs ~$5,200-$12,600.

band.unit: sum (whole external reticulation installation, one site, 250 m nominal route)
band.basis: Working cost-plan band, GST exclusive, NZD, Auckland, for the fixed scope only (incoming supply, network connection, transformer, main switchboard, metering, poles/luminaires, comms/CCTV, rock/contaminated spoil, dewatering, traffic management, EV/generator provisions and paving beyond the trench line excluded). Built from QV CostBuilder (PlanCheck) published rates - all rows UNREVIEWED - plus labelled allowances for minor items with no published rate. Part subtotals: trenching & reinstatement $20,532-30,047; conduit & cable $74,180-92,625; pits $9,872-12,972; board & spurs $4,572-7,444; testing/CoC allowance $1,500-3,000. Allowances carry about 5-8% of the total, well under a third. Implied rate over the 250 m nominal route: $443/m (low) to $584/m (high), central ~$513/m; central lump sum ~$128,000. Confidence is LOW because (a) QV's buried-conduit section is internally inconsistent and its rates sit far above material cost (web cross-check: 63 mm HD AS/NZS 2053 conduit supply is about AUD 8.8/m), and the conduit + sub-main sections carry ~60% of the total; (b) the sub-main is proxied between a fire-rated 4-core row and a single-core copper row; (c) QV rates include commercial overheads and margin that cannot be stripped out. A competitively tendered price could fall below the low end. QV rates exclude GST; preliminaries and margin are not added separately.

band.unit: sum (lump sum for the whole external reticulation installation, one 3,000 m2 site)
band.basis: Sum of the priced components above. GST-exclusive, NZD, Auckland rates. Excludes preliminaries, margin, design and consent fees, the incoming supply/network connection/transformer/main switchboard/metering, lighting poles/footings/luminaires/controls, CCTV/comms active equipment, rock, contaminated spoil, dewatering, traffic management, a second sub-main, generator or EV provision, and paving/kerbing/landscaping beyond the trench line. Implied rate over the 250 m nominal route: approx. $390/m (low) to $558/m (high), centre approx. $474/m — so the amortisation is auditable. Component shares of the centre: trenching & reinstatement ~15%, conduit & cable ~60%, pits ~8%, board & spurs ~5%, testing/CoC/as-built ~2%. Allowances (not published rates) carry roughly 11–14% of the total, well under one third. Confidence is LOW: the largest component (conduit) rests on an unreviewed QV row with no 63 mm equivalent and an inconsistent 100 mm sibling; the sub-main uses a fire-rated 4-core proxy discounted by judgement; the pits and board plinth are allowances because no NZ supplier price was published. Note the QV buried-conduit rates look high against typical trade rates for 63/32 mm orange PVC; if a reviewer rejects that component the band falls materially.
